p0.original: Economists use a vocabulary of maximizing utility to describe people’s preferences. In Consumer Choices, the level of utility that a person receives is described in numerical terms. This appendix presents an alternative approach to describing personal preferences, called indifference curves, which avoids any need for using numbers to measure utility. By setting aside the assumption of putting a numerical valuation on utility—an assumption that many students and economists find uncomfortably unrealistic—the indifference curve framework helps to clarify the logic of the underlying model.
p0.zh: 经济学家们用一个尽可能发挥效用的词汇来描述人们的偏好. 在“消费者选择”中,用数字来描述一个人获得的效用水平。 本附录提出了描述个人偏好的一种替代方法,称为冷漠曲线,避免了使用数字来衡量效用的任何需要.冷漠曲线框架搁置了对效用进行数字估值的假设——即许多学生和经济学家认为不切实际的假设——有助于澄清基本模型的逻辑。

p2.original: People cannot really put a numerical value on their level of satisfaction. However, they can, and do, identify what choices would give them more, or less, or the same amount of satisfaction. An indifference curve shows combinations of goods that provide an equal level of utility or satisfaction. For example,  presents three indifference curves that represent Lilly’s preferences for the tradeoffs that she faces in her two main relaxation activities: eating doughnuts and reading paperback books. Each indifference curve (Ul, Um, and Uh) represents one level of utility. First we will explore the meaning of one particular indifference curve and then we will look at the indifference curves as a group.
p2.zh: 人们不能真正地把数字价值放在满意程度上。 然而,它们能够并且确实能够确定哪些选择会给予它们更多或更少的满足,或者提供同样数量的满足。冷漠曲线显示各种商品的组合,它们提供了同等程度的效用或满意度。 例如, 呈现出三条冷漠曲线, 代表莉莉在两大放松活动中所面对权衡的喜好:吃甜甜圈和阅读书本。 每个冷漠曲线(Ul,Um,和Uh)代表一个级的效用. 首先,我们将探索一种特殊的冷漠曲线的含义,然后我们作为一个群体来看待冷漠曲线。

p4.original: The Shape of an Indifference Curve

p5.original: The indifference curve Um has four points labeled on it: A, B, C, and D. Since an indifference curve represents a set of choices that have the same level of utility, Lilly must receive an equal amount of utility, judged according to her personal preferences, from two books and 120 doughnuts (point A), from three books and 84 doughnuts (point B) from 11 books and 40 doughnuts (point C) or from 12 books and 35 doughnuts (point D). She would also receive the same utility from any of the unlabeled intermediate points along this indifference curve.
p5.zh: 冷漠曲线Um上面标有四个点:A,B,C,和D. 由于冷漠曲线代表着一套具有同等效用的选择,莉莉必须获得同等效用,根据她个人的偏好来判断,从两本书和120个甜甜圈(A点),从三本书和84个甜甜圈(B点),从11本书和40个甜甜圈(C点),或从12本书和35个甜甜圈(D点)获得. 她也会从这个冷漠曲线上的任何未加标签的中间点得到同样的效用。

p6.original: Indifference curves have a roughly similar shape in two ways: 1) they are downward sloping from left to right; 2) they are convex with respect to the origin. In other words, they are steeper on the left and flatter on the right. The downward slope of the indifference curve means that Lilly must trade off less of one good to get more of the other, while holding utility constant. For example, points A and B sit on the same indifference curve Um, which means that they provide Lilly with the same level of utility. Thus, the marginal utility that Lilly would gain from, say, increasing her consumption of books from two to three must be equal to the marginal utility that she would lose if her consumption of doughnuts was cut from 120 to 84—so that her overall utility remains unchanged between points A and B. Indeed, the slope along an indifference curve as the marginal rate of substitution, which is the rate at which a person is willing to trade one good for another so that utility will remain the same.
p6.zh: 偏差曲线的形状在两种方面大致相似:(1)它们从左向右向下斜斜;(2)它们与原生地相比是凸起的.换句话说,它们左边更陡,右边更恭维.冷漠曲线的下坡意味着丽丽必须用少一点的好来换取更多其他的好,同时保持效用不变. 例如,A点和B点坐落在同样的冷漠曲线Um上,这意味着它们为Lily提供了同样水平的效用. 因此,Lilly从书本消费从2到3增加而获得的边际效用必须等于她如果将甜甜圈的消费从120减少到84而失去的边际效用——这样,她的总体效用在A点和B点之间保持不变。 事实上,冷漠曲线上的坡度作为边际替代率,即一个人愿意将一个利益交易给另一个利益从而保持效用的速率。

p7.original: Indifference curves like Um are steeper on the left and flatter on the right. The reason behind this shape involves diminishing marginal utility—the notion that as a person consumes more of a good, the marginal utility from each additional unit becomes lower. Compare two different choices between points that all provide Lilly an equal amount of utility along the indifference curve Um: the choice between A and B, and between C and D. In both choices, Lilly consumes one more book, but between A and B her consumption of doughnuts falls by 36 (from 120 to 84) and between C and D it falls by only five (from 40 to 35). The reason for this difference is that points A and C are different starting points, and thus have different implications for marginal utility. At point A, Lilly has few books and many doughnuts. Thus, her marginal utility from an extra book will be relatively high while the marginal utility of additional doughnuts is relatively low—so on the margin, it will take a relatively large number of doughnuts to offset the utility from the marginal book. At point C, however, Lilly has many books and few doughnuts. From this starting point, her marginal utility gained from extra books will be relatively low, while the marginal utility lost from additional doughnuts would be relatively high—so on the margin, it will take a relatively smaller number of doughnuts to offset the change of one marginal book. In short, the slope of the indifference curve changes because the marginal rate of substitution—that is, the quantity of one good that would be traded for the other good to keep utility constant—also changes, as a result of diminishing marginal utility of both goods.
p7.zh: 诸如Um这样的偏差曲线在左侧较陡,在右侧较夸张. 这种形状背后的原因涉及到边际效用的减少——即一个人消费更多商品,每个额外单位的边际效用就会降低。比较两个点之间的不同选择,这些点都沿着冷漠曲线为莉莉提供了同等数量的效用 Um:A和B之间,C和D之间的选择. 在这两种选择中,莉莉又消耗了一本书,但在A和B之间,她对甜甜圈的消费下降了36(从120到84),而在C和D之间,它只减少了5(从40到35). 这种区别的原因是A点和C点是不同的起点,因此对边际效用有不同的影响.到了A点,莉莉几乎没有书和许多甜甜圈. 因此,她从一本额外书籍中获取的边际用途会相对较高,而额外甜甜圈的边际用途相对较低——因此,从边际书籍中抵消边际用途需要相对大量的甜甜圈. 然而,在C点,莉莉有许多书籍和很少的甜甜圈. 从这个起点开始,她从额外书籍中获得的边际效用会相对较低,而从额外甜甜圈中损失的边际效用会相对较高——因此从边际来看,需要相对较少的甜甜圈来抵消一个边际书籍的变更.简言之,冷漠曲线的坡度发生变化,因为边际替代率——即一种货物的数量为另一种货物而交易,以保持效用不变——也发生变化,因为这两种货物的边际用途都在减少。

p9.original: Each indifference curve represents the choices that provide a single level of utility. Every level of utility will have its own indifference curve. Thus, Lilly’s preferences will include an infinite number of indifference curves lying nestled together on the diagram—even though only three of the indifference curves, representing three levels of utility, appear on . In other words, an infinite number of indifference curves are not drawn on this diagram—but you should remember that they exist.
p9.zh: 每个冷漠曲线代表了提供单一水平效用的选择.每一个层次的效用都会有自己的冷漠曲线. 因此,莉莉的偏好将包括无穷无尽的冷漠曲线在图上凝聚在一起,尽管只有三个冷漠曲线(代表三个实用级)出现。换句话说,在这个图上没有绘制无数的冷漠曲线,但是你应该记住它们的存在。

p10.original: Higher indifference curves represent a greater level of utility than lower ones. In , indifference curve Ul can be thought of as a “low” level of utility, while Um is a “medium” level of utility and Uh is a “high” level of utility. All of the choices on indifference curve Uh are preferred to all of the choices on indifference curve Um, which in turn are preferred to all of the choices on Ul.
p10.zh: 更高的冷漠曲线比较低的曲线的实用性要高。 在“冷漠曲线”中,Ul可被认为是“低”级的效用,而Um是“中”级的效用,Uh是“高”级的效用。冷漠曲线上的所有选择 Uh 都比冷漠曲线上的所有选择更受欢迎 Um 反之 冷漠曲线上的所有选择都更受欢迎

p11.original: To understand why higher indifference curves are preferred to lower ones, compare point B on indifference curve Um to point F on indifference curve Uh. Point F has greater consumption of both books (five to three) and doughnuts (100 to 84), so point F is clearly preferable to point B. Given the definition of an indifference curve—that all the points on the curve have the same level of utility—if point F on indifference curve Uh is preferred to point B on indifference curve Um, then it must be true that all points on indifference curve Uh have a higher level of utility than all points on Um. More generally, for any point on a lower indifference curve, like Ul, you can identify a point on a higher indifference curve like Um or Uh that has a higher consumption of both goods. Since one point on the higher indifference curve is preferred to one point on the lower curve, and since all the points on a given indifference curve have the same level of utility, it must be true that all points on higher indifference curves have greater utility than all points on lower indifference curves.
p11.zh: 为了理解为什么高冷漠曲线比低冷漠曲线要好, 比较冷漠曲线上的B点 Um 比较冷漠曲线上的F点 Uh.F点的书消耗量较大(五至三本)和甜甜圈消耗量较大(100至84本),因此F点显然比B点要好. 如果在无动于衷曲线上F点 偏好在无动于衷曲线上B点 那么所有在无动于衷曲线上的点 都比在Um上的所有点都有用更一般地说,对于低等冷漠曲线上的任何一点,比如Ul,你可以在更高等的冷漠曲线上识别出一个对两种商品具有较高消耗的点. 由于较高无动于衷曲线的一点比较低曲线的一点更受欢迎,而且由于特定无动于衷曲线上的所有点都具有同等的实用性,因此,在较高无动于衷曲线上的所有点都比低无动于衷曲线上的所有点都具有更大的实用性,这一定是事实.

p12.original: These arguments about the shapes of indifference curves and about higher or lower levels of utility do not require any numerical estimates of utility, either by the individual or by anyone else. They are only based on the assumptions that when people have less of one good they need more of another good to make up for it, if they are keeping the same level of utility, and that as people have more of a good, the marginal utility they receive from additional units of that good will diminish. Given these gentle assumptions, a field of indifference curves can be mapped out to describe the preferences of any individual.
p12.zh: 这些关于冷漠曲线形状和效用水平高低的论据不需要对效用进行任何数字估计,无论是由个人还是由任何其他人。 它们只是基于这样的假设:当人们拥有的一件物品少于一件的时候,他们需要更多的另一件物品来弥补它,如果他们保持同样的效用水平,而随着人们拥有更多的物品,他们从这些物品的额外单位中得到的边际效用将会减少。 鉴于这些温柔的假设,可以绘制出一个冷漠曲线领域,来描述任何个人的偏好.

p14.original: Each person determines their own preferences and utility. Thus, while indifference curves have the same general shape—they slope down, and the slope is steeper on the left and flatter on the right—the specific shape of indifference curves can be different for every person. , for example, applies only to Lilly’s preferences. Indifference curves for other people would probably travel through different points.
p14.zh: 每个人决定自己的喜好和效用. 因此,虽然冷漠曲线具有相同的一般形状——它们向下倾斜,斜坡在左侧较陡,在右侧较夸张——但冷漠曲线的具体形状对每个人来说可能不同。 例如,它只适用于莉莉的偏好。 对其他人来说,偏差曲线可能会穿过不同的点。

p15.zh: 用偏移曲线进行工具最大化

p16.original: People seek the highest level of utility, which means that they wish to be on the highest possible indifference curve. However, people are limited by their budget constraints, which show what tradeoffs are actually possible.
p16.zh: 人们寻求最高的效用,这意味着他们希望处于尽可能高的冷漠曲线上. 然而,人们受到预算限制的限制,这显示出实际可以作出何种权衡。

p17.original: Maximizing Utility at the Highest Indifference Curve
p17.zh: 在最高偏差曲线上最大化工具

p18.original: Return to the situation of Lilly’s choice between paperback books and doughnuts. Say that books cost $6, doughnuts are 50 cents each, and that Lilly has $60 to spend. This information provides the basis for the budget line shown in . Along with the budget line are shown the three indifference curves from . What is Lilly’s utility-maximizing choice? Several possibilities are identified in the diagram.
p18.zh: 回到丽丽在书本和甜甜圈之间做出选择的境地。说书价六块,甜甜圈每块50美分,丽丽有60块花.这些资料为第...段所示预算项目提供了依据。与预算项目一起显示三个冷漠曲线。莉莉的功用最大化选择是什么?图表中列出了几种可能性。

p19.original: Indifference Curves and a Budget Constraint

p20.original: The choice of F with five books and 100 doughnuts is highly desirable, since it is on the highest indifference curve Uh of those shown in the diagram. However, it is not affordable given Lilly’s budget constraint. The choice of H with three books and 70 doughnuts on indifference curve Ul is a wasteful choice, since it is inside Lilly’s budget set, and as a utility-maximizer, Lilly will always prefer a choice on the budget constraint itself. Choices B and G are both on the opportunity set. However, choice G of six books and 48 doughnuts is on lower indifference curve Ul than choice B of three books and 84 doughnuts, which is on the indifference curve Um. If Lilly were to start at choice G, and then thought about whether the marginal utility she was deriving from doughnuts and books, she would decide that some additional doughnuts and fewer books would make her happier—which would cause her to move toward her preferred choice B. Given the combination of Lilly’s personal preferences, as identified by her indifference curves, and Lilly’s opportunity set, which is determined by prices and income, B will be her utility-maximizing choice.
p20.zh: 选择F配有五本书和100个甜甜圈是非常可取的,因为它处于最高的冷漠曲线上。 然而,由于莉莉的预算拮据,这种负担是无法承受的。选择H 和三本书和70个甜甜圈放在冷漠曲线 Ul 是个浪费的选择,因为它在Lilly的预算范围内,并且作为一个功用最大者,Lilly总是更喜欢选择预算限制本身。选择B和G 都在机会设定上。 然而,六本书和48个甜甜圈的G选择比三本书和84个甜甜圈的B选择低,后者处于冷漠曲线 Um. 如果莉莉从选择G开始,然后考虑她是否从甜甜圈和书籍中衍生的边际效用,她会决定,一些额外的甜甜圈和更少的书籍会让她更快乐,这会使她转向她偏爱的选择B. 考虑到莉莉的个人偏好(由她冷漠的曲线所识别)和莉莉的机会设定(由价格和收入决定)的结合,B将是她最大的效用选择。

p21.original: The highest achievable indifference curve touches the opportunity set at a single point of tangency. Since an infinite number of indifference curves exist, even if only a few of them are drawn on any given diagram, there will always exist one indifference curve that touches the budget line at a single point of tangency. All higher indifference curves, like Uh, will be completely above the budget line and, although the choices on that indifference curve would provide higher utility, they are not affordable given the budget set. All lower indifference curves, like Ul, will cross the budget line in two separate places. When one indifference curve crosses the budget line in two places, however, there will be another, higher, attainable indifference curve sitting above it that touches the budget line at only one point of tangency.
p21.zh: 最高的可实现的冷漠曲线触及了在单一紧凑点上设定的机会. 由于存在无限数量的冷漠曲线,即使其中只有少数的冷漠曲线是在任何特定图表上绘制的,但总会有一个冷漠曲线在一瞬间触及预算项目. 所有更高的冷漠曲线,如Uh, 将完全高于预算项目, 虽然冷漠曲线上的选择会提供更高的效用, 所有较低的无动于衷曲线,如Ul,将在两个不同的地方跨越预算线. 然而,当一个冷漠曲线在两个地方跨越预算项目时,就会有另一个更高的、可以实现的冷漠曲线坐落在它上面,它只触及一个不切实际的预算项目。

p23.original: A rise in income causes the budget constraint to shift to the right. In graphical terms, the new budget constraint will now be tangent to a higher indifference curve, representing a higher level of utility. A reduction in income will cause the budget constraint to shift to the left, which will cause it to be tangent to a lower indifference curve, representing a reduced level of utility. If income rises by, for example, 50%, exactly how much will a person alter consumption of books and doughnuts? Will consumption of both goods rise by 50%, or will the quantity of one good rise substantially, while the quantity of the other good rises only a little, or even declines?
p23.zh: 收入增加导致预算拮据,转向右翼。 从图表上看,新的预算约束现在将接近于更高的无动于衷的曲线,这代表了更高的效用水平。收入的减少将导致预算限制转向左侧,这将导致它与较低的无动于衷曲线接近,表明效用水平下降。 例如,如果收入增加50%,那么一个人会改变书本和甜甜圈的消费额?这两种商品的消费是否会增加50%,或者一种商品的数量会大幅度增加,而另一种商品的数量只会增加一点,甚至会减少?

p24.original: Since personal preferences and the shape of indifference curves are different for each individual, the response to changes in income will be different, too. For example, consider the preferences of Manuel and Natasha in  (a) and  (b). They each start with an identical income of $40, which they spend on yogurts that cost $1 and rental movies that cost $4. Thus, they face identical budget constraints. However, based on Manuel’s preferences, as revealed by his indifference curves, his utility-maximizing choice on the original budget set occurs where his opportunity set is tangent to the highest possible indifference curve at W, with three movies and 28 yogurts, while Natasha’s utility-maximizing choice on the original budget set at Y will be seven movies and 12 yogurts.
p24.zh: 由于每个人的个人偏好和冷漠曲线的形状不同,对收入变化的反应也会不同. 例如,在(a)和(b)中考虑曼努埃尔和娜塔莎的偏好. 他们各自以相同的40美元收入开始,他们花在花费1美元的酸奶和花费4美元的出租电影上. 因此,它们面临同样的预算限制。 然而,基于曼努埃尔的偏好,正如他冷漠曲线所揭示的那样,他对于原始预算组合的效用最大化选择发生在他的机会设定与W的尽可能高的冷漠曲线接近的地方,有三部电影和28部酸奶,而娜塔莎对于Y的原始预算组合的效用最大化选择将是七部电影和12部酸奶.

p25.zh: 曼努埃尔和娜塔莎的漠不关心曲线

p26.original: Now, say that income rises to $60 for both Manuel and Natasha, so their budget constraints shift to the right. As shown in  (a), Manuel’s new utility maximizing choice at X will be seven movies and 32 yogurts—that is, Manuel will choose to spend most of the extra income on movies. Natasha’s new utility maximizing choice at Z will be eight movies and 28 yogurts—that is, she will choose to spend most of the extra income on yogurt. In this way, the indifference curve approach allows for a range of possible responses. However, if both goods are normal goods, then the typical response to a higher level of income will be to purchase more of them—although exactly how much more is a matter of personal preference. If one of the goods is an inferior good, the response to a higher level of income will be to purchase less of it.
p26.zh: 现在说曼努埃尔和娜塔莎的收入都上升到60美元 所以他们的预算限制转移到了右边 如(a)所示,曼努埃尔在X的新的功能最大化选择将是七部电影和32部酸奶,即曼努埃尔将选择将大部分额外收入花在电影上.娜塔莎在Z的新功能是8部电影和28部酸奶, 这样,无动于衷的曲线方法允许一系列可能的响应. 然而,如果这两种货物都是正常货物,那么对较高收入水平的典型反应将是购买更多的货物——尽管确切地说,更多的货物是个人偏好的问题。 如果其中一种商品是劣质商品,那么对较高水平收入的反应就是购买较少.

p27.original: Responses to Price Changes: Substitution and Income Effects
p27.zh: 对价格变化的反应:替代和收入影响

p28.original: A higher price for a good will cause the budget constraint to shift to the left, so that it is tangent to a lower indifference curve representing a reduced level of utility. Conversely, a lower price for a good will cause the opportunity set to shift to the right, so that it is tangent to a higher indifference curve representing an increased level of utility. Exactly how much a change in price will lead to the quantity demanded of each good will depend on personal preferences.
p28.zh: 提高好价钱会导致预算限制转向左侧,因此它与较低冷漠曲线接近,表明效用水平下降。反之,低廉的商品价格会导致机会向右转移,从而使它与更高程度的无动于衷的曲线相吻合,而这种曲线代表了效用水平的提高。价格变动将在多大程度上导致对每件货物的需求量取决于个人的偏好。

p29.original: Anyone who faces a change in price will experience two interlinked motivations: a substitution effect and an income effect. The substitution effect is that when a good becomes more expensive, people seek out substitutes. If oranges become more expensive, fruit-lovers scale back on oranges and eat more apples, grapefruit, or raisins. Conversely, when a good becomes cheaper, people substitute toward consuming more. If oranges get cheaper, people fire up their juicing machines and ease off on other fruits and foods. The income effect refers to how a change in the price of a good alters the effective buying power of one’s income. If the price of a good that you have been buying falls, then in effect your buying power has risen—you are able to purchase more goods. Conversely, if the price of a good that you have been buying rises, then the buying power of a given amount of income is diminished. (One common source of confusion is that the “income effect” does not refer to a change in actual income. Instead, it refers to the situation in which the price of a good changes, and thus the quantities of goods that can be purchased with a fixed amount of income change. It might be more accurate to call the “income effect” a “buying power effect,” but the “income effect” terminology has been used for decades, and it is not going to change during this economics course.) Whenever a price changes, consumers feel the pull of both substitution and income effects at the same time.
p29.zh: 任何面临价格变化的人将经历两个相互关联的动机:替代效应和收入效应。替代效应是,当商品价格提高时,人们会寻找替代品。 如果橘子变得比较昂贵,那么爱果子的人就会在橙子上缩回,吃更多的苹果,柚子,或葡萄干.反之,当一种商品变得便宜时,人们就会取代消费。 如果橘子更便宜,人们会点燃他们的汁液机,并放松其他水果和食品的消费.收入影响是指货物价格的变动如何改变个人收入的有效购买力。 如果你买的商品的价格下跌,那么实际上你的购买力已经提高,你可以购买更多的商品。反之,如果你购买的商品的价格上升,那么一定收入的购买力就会减弱。(一个常见的混淆来源是,“收入影响”并不指实际收入的变化。) 相反,它指的是好货的价格变化的情况,从而是指可以以固定收入金额改变而购买的货物数量。将“收入效应”称为“购买力效应”可能更为准确,但“收入效应”术语已经使用了几十年,而且在这一经济学过程中不会发生变化。 )每当价格发生变化时,消费者都会同时感受到替代效应和收入效应的牵引力。

p30.original: Using indifference curves, you can illustrate the substitution and income effects on a graph. In , Ogden faces a choice between two goods: haircuts or personal pizzas. Haircuts cost $20, personal pizzas cost $6, and he has $120 to spend.
p30.zh: 使用冷漠曲线,可以在图表上说明替代和收入影响. 在 . Ogden面临两种商品的选择:理发或个人披萨.剪发费20美元,个人披萨费6美元,他还有120美元要花.

p32.original: The price of haircuts rises to $30. Ogden starts at choice A on the higher opportunity set and the higher indifference curve. After the price of haircuts increases, he chooses B on the lower opportunity set and the lower indifference curve. Point B with two haircuts and 10 personal pizzas is immediately below point A with three haircuts and 10 personal pizzas, showing that Ogden reacted to a higher price of haircuts by cutting back only on haircuts, while leaving his consumption of pizza unchanged.
p32.zh: 理发价格上涨至30元. 奥格登从选择A开始,在更高的机会集和更高的冷漠曲线上. 在理发价格上涨后,他选择了B在下限机会集和下限冷漠曲线上.有两个发型和10个个人披萨的B点就在A点下方,有三个发型和10个个人披萨,显示奥格登只剪头发就对更高的理发价格反应,同时他的披萨消费没有改变.

p33.original: The dashed line in the diagram, and point C, are used to separate the substitution effect and the income effect. To understand their function, start by thinking about the substitution effect with this question: How would Ogden change his consumption if the relative prices of the two goods changed, but this change in relative prices did not affect his utility? The slope of the budget constraint is determined by the relative price of the two goods; thus, the slope of the original budget line is determined by the original relative prices, while the slope of the new budget line is determined by the new relative prices. With this thought in mind, the dashed line is a graphical tool inserted in a specific way: It is inserted so that it is parallel with the new budget constraint, so it reflects the new relative prices, but it is tangent to the original indifference curve, so it reflects the original level of utility or buying power.
p33.zh: 图表中的虚线和C点用于区分替代效应和收入效应。 为了理解它们的功能,首先思考一下这个问题的替代效应:如果两件商品的相对价格发生变化,奥格登会如何改变他的消费,但是这种相对价格的变化并没有影响他的效用?预算约束的坡度由两件商品的相对价格决定;因此,原预算项目坡度由原相对价格决定,而新预算项目坡度由新相对价格决定. 考虑到这一想法,虚线是用特定方式插入的图形工具: 插入它是为了与新的预算限制平行,所以它反映了新的相对价格,但它与原始的冷漠曲线是切合的,因此它反映了原有的效用或购买力的水平.

p34.original: Thus, the movement from the original choice (A) to point C is a substitution effect; it shows the choice that Ogden would make if relative prices shifted (as shown by the different slope between the original budget set and the dashed line) but if buying power did not shift (as shown by being tangent to the original indifference curve). The substitution effect will encourage people to shift away from the good which has become relatively more expensive—in Ogden’s case, the haircuts on the vertical axis—and toward the good which has become relatively less expensive—in this case, the pizza on the vertical axis. The two arrows labeled with “s” for “substitution effect,” one on each axis, show the direction of this movement.
p34.zh: 因此,从原选择(A)到点C的移动是一种替代效应;它显示了奥格登如果相对价格发生变动(如原预算设定与虚线之间的不同坡度所显示),但购买力没有转移(如与原冷漠曲线相对应所显示的),则奥格登会作出的选择.替代效应将鼓励人们从已经变得相对昂贵的商品(Ogden)转向垂直轴线上的剪发品(Ogden), 转向相对相对便宜的商品(Pizza),标有“s”的“替代效果”的两支箭头,每个轴上各一箭头,显示了这一运动的方向。

p35.original: The income effect is the movement from point C to B, which shows how Ogden reacts to a reduction in his buying power from the higher indifference curve to the lower indifference curve, but holding constant the relative prices (because the dashed line has the same slope as the new budget constraint). In this case, where the price of one good increases, buying power is reduced, so the income effect means that consumption of both goods should fall (if they are both normal goods, which it is reasonable to assume unless there is reason to believe otherwise). The two arrows labeled with “i” for “income effect,” one on each axis, show the direction of this income effect movement.
p35.zh: 收入效应是从C点到B点的移动,这显示了奥格登如何对从更高的冷漠曲线到较低的冷漠曲线的购买力下降作出反应,但保持相对价格不变(因为破折线与新的预算限制具有相同的坡度). 在这种情况下,如果一种商品的价格上涨,购买力就会下降,所以收入效应意味着两种商品的消费都应该下降(如果两者都是正常商品,那么可以合理地假设,除非有理由相信有其他商品的话).以“i”表示的“收入效应”的两支箭头,每个轴上各一箭头,显示了这种收入效应运动的方向。

p36.original: Now, put the substitution and income effects together. When the price of pizza increased, Ogden consumed less of it, for two reasons shown in the exhibit: the substitution effect of the higher price led him to consume less and the income effect of the higher price also led him to consume less. However, when the price of pizza increased, Ogden consumed the same quantity of haircuts. The substitution effect of a higher price for pizza meant that haircuts became relatively less expensive (compared to pizza), and this factor, taken alone, would have encouraged Ogden to consume more haircuts. However, the income effect of a higher price for pizza meant that he wished to consume less of both goods, and this factor, taken alone, would have encouraged Ogden to consume fewer haircuts. As shown in , in this particular example the substitution effect and income effect on Ogden’s consumption of haircuts are offsetting—so he ends up consuming the same quantity of haircuts after the price increase for pizza as before.
p36.zh: 现在,把替代和收入效应放在一起。 当披萨价格上涨时,奥格登消费较少,原因在展品中显示出两个:高价的替代效应导致他消费较少,高价的收入效应也导致他消费较少. 然而,当披萨价格上涨时,奥格登也消耗了同样数量的发型. 比萨饼价格较高的替代效应意味着理发价格相对较低(比萨饼),而这个因素单是这个因素就会鼓励奥格登消费更多的理发. 然而,比萨饼价格较高对收入的影响意味着他希望减少两种商品的消费,而这一因素单独地会鼓励奥格登减少理发.特别是这个例子显示, 对欧格登的理发消费的替代效应和收入影响正在抵消—— 所以他最后在披萨价格上涨后, 也像以前一样消耗同样的理发量。

p37.original: The size of these income and substitution effects will differ from person to person, depending on individual preferences. For example, if Ogden’s substitution effect away from pizza and toward haircuts is especially strong, and outweighs the income effect, then a higher price for pizza might lead to increased consumption of haircuts. This case would be drawn on the graph so that the point of tangency between the new budget constraint and the relevant indifference curve occurred below point B and to the right. Conversely, if the substitution effect away from pizza and toward haircuts is not as strong, and the income effect on is relatively stronger, then Ogden will be more likely to react to the higher price of pizza by consuming less of both goods. In this case, his optimal choice after the price change will be above and to the left of choice B on the new budget constraint.
p37.zh: 这些收入和替代效应的规模因个人偏好而异。 例如,如果奥格登的替代效应远离比萨饼和理发效果特别强烈,并且超过收入效应,那么比萨饼价格的提高可能导致理发消费的增加。案件将按图表来划分,这样,新的预算限制与相关的冷漠曲线之间的距离就会在B点以下和右边出现。反之,如果从披萨到理发的替代效应没有那么强烈,而且对收入的影响也相对较强,那么奥格登就更有可能通过消耗更少的两种商品来应对披萨价格的上涨. 在这种情况下,他在价格变动后的最佳选择将高于新的预算限制,而由左侧选择B。

p38.original: Although the substitution and income effects are often discussed as a sequence of events, it should be remembered that they are twin components of a single cause—a change in price. Although you can analyze them separately, the two effects are always proceeding hand in hand, happening at the same time.
p38.zh: 虽然替代和收入影响常常作为一系列事件讨论,但应当记住,它们是单一原因的双重组成部分——价格变化。 尽管你可以分别分析它们,但这两种效果总是同时进行,同时发生.

p39.original: Indifference Curves with Labor-Leisure and Intertemporal Choices
p39.zh: 带有劳动休闲和间歇选择的偏差曲线

p40.original: The concept of an indifference curve applies to tradeoffs in any household choice, including the labor-leisure choice or the intertemporal choice between present and future consumption. In the labor-leisure choice, each indifference curve shows the combinations of leisure and income that provide a certain level of utility. In an intertemporal choice, each indifference curve shows the combinations of present and future consumption that provide a certain level of utility. The general shapes of the indifference curves—downward sloping, steeper on the left and flatter on the right—also remain the same.
p40.zh: 冷漠曲线的概念适用于任何家庭选择中的权衡,包括劳动-感情选择或当前和未来消费之间的时际选择。 在劳动-运动选择中,每个冷漠曲线都显示休闲和收入的组合,提供了一定的效用. 在间歇性选择中,每个冷漠曲线都显示当前和未来消费的组合,这些组合提供了一定的效用.冷漠曲线的一般形状——向下倾斜,左侧较陡,右侧较夸张——也保持不变。

p42.original: Petunia is working at a job that pays $12 per hour but she gets a raise to $20 per hour. After family responsibilities and sleep, she has 80 hours per week available for work or leisure. As shown in , the highest level of utility for Petunia, on her original budget constraint, is at choice A, where it is tangent to the lower indifference curve (Ul). Point A has 30 hours of leisure and thus 50 hours per week of work, with income of $600 per week (that is, 50 hours of work at $12 per hour). Petunia then gets a raise to $20 per hour, which shifts her budget constraint to the right. Her new utility-maximizing choice occurs where the new budget constraint is tangent to the higher indifference curve Uh. At B, Petunia has 40 hours of leisure per week and works 40 hours, with income of $800 per week (that is, 40 hours of work at $20 per hour).
p42.zh: Petunia在一份每小时12美元的工作上工作 但她每小时能涨到20美元 在承担家庭责任和睡觉之后,她每周有80小时的工作或休闲时间。 如前文所示,佩图尼亚在最初的预算限制下,其最高的效用水平是选择A,与下层的冷漠曲线(Ul)接近.A点有30小时的闲暇时间,因此每周工作50小时,收入为每周600美元(即每小时12美元50小时)。Petunia随后被加薪到每小时20美元,这让她的预算限制转向右侧. 她的新功能最大化选择 发生在新的预算限制 与更高的冷漠曲线接近的地方 Uh. 在B级,佩图尼亚每周有40小时的闲暇时间,工作40小时,收入为每周800美元(即每小时20美元40小时的工作).

p43.original: Effects of a Change in Petunia’s Wage
p43.zh: 佩图尼亚工资变动的影响

p44.original: Substitution and income effects provide a vocabulary for discussing how Petunia reacts to a higher hourly wage. The dashed line serves as the tool for separating the two effects on the graph.
p44.zh: 替代和收入影响为讨论佩图尼亚如何对较高的小时工资作出反应提供了一个词汇。破折的线条是区分图上两种效果的工具.

p45.original: The substitution effect tells how Petunia would have changed her hours of work if her wage had risen, so that income was relatively cheaper to earn and leisure was relatively more expensive, but if she had remained at the same level of utility. The slope of the budget constraint in a labor-leisure diagram is determined by the wage rate. Thus, the dashed line is carefully inserted with the slope of the new opportunity set, reflecting the labor-leisure tradeoff of the new wage rate, but tangent to the original indifference curve, showing the same level of utility or “buying power.” The shift from original choice A to point C, which is the point of tangency between the original indifference curve and the dashed line, shows that because of the higher wage, Petunia will want to consume less leisure and more income. The “s” arrows on the horizontal and vertical axes of  show the substitution effect on leisure and on income.
p45.zh: 替代效应说明,如果佩图尼亚的工资提高,她会怎样改变她的工作时间,这样收入收入就比较便宜,而休闲则比较昂贵,但如果她保持同样的效用水平.劳动-劳动保障图中预算约束的坡度由工资率决定。 因此,破折叠线被小心插入新机会设置的坡度中,反映了新工资率的劳动-利弊权衡,但与最初的冷漠曲线恰好吻合,显示同样水平的效用或“购买力 ” 。 从最初的选择A到C点的转变,这是原冷漠曲线与破折叠线之间的不切实际点,这表明由于工资较高,佩图尼亚想要消耗更少的闲暇和更多的收入。横向和纵向轴线上的“s”箭头显示了对休闲和收入的替代效应。

p46.original: The income effect is that the higher wage, by shifting the labor-leisure budget constraint to the right, makes it possible for Petunia to reach a higher level of utility. The income effect is the movement from point C to point B; that is, it shows how Petunia’s behavior would change in response to a higher level of utility or “buying power,” with the wage rate remaining the same (as shown by the dashed line being parallel to the new budget constraint). The income effect, encouraging Petunia to consume both more leisure and more income, is drawn with arrows on the horizontal and vertical axis of .
p46.zh: 收入效应是,工资越高,劳动-劳动保障预算限制越向右转移,便有可能使Petunia达到更高的效用水平。收入效应是从C点到B点的移动;也就是说,它表明佩图尼亚的行为会因更高水平的公用事业或“购买力”而改变,工资率保持不变(如虚线与新的预算限制平行所示 ) 。收入效应鼓励Petunia同时消耗更多的闲暇和更多的收入,在......的横向和纵向轴线上用箭头划出。

p47.original: Putting these effects together, Petunia responds to the higher wage by moving from choice A to choice B. This movement involves choosing more income, both because the substitution effect of higher wages has made income relatively cheaper or easier to earn, and because the income effect of higher wages has made it possible to have more income and more leisure. Her movement from A to B also involves choosing more leisure because, according to Petunia’s preferences, the income effect that encourages choosing more leisure is stronger than the substitution effect that encourages choosing less leisure.
p47.zh: 综合这些效应,佩图尼亚通过从选择A转向选择B来应对工资较高的问题. 这一变化涉及选择更多的收入,因为工资高的替代效应使收入相对便宜或更容易赚取,而且工资高的收入效应也使得收入增加和休闲增加成为可能。 她从A到B的移动也涉及选择更多休闲,因为根据佩图尼亚的偏好,鼓励选择更多休闲的收入效应比鼓励选择更少休闲的替代效应更强.

p48.original: represents only Petunia’s preferences. Other people might make other choices. For example, a person whose substitution and income effects on leisure exactly counterbalanced each other might react to a higher wage with a choice like D, exactly above the original choice A, which means taking all of the benefit of the higher wages in the form of income while working the same number of hours. Yet another person, whose substitution effect on leisure outweighed the income effect, might react to a higher wage by making a choice like F, where the response to higher wages is to work more hours and earn much more income. To represent these different preferences, you could easily draw the indifference curve Uh to be tangent to the new budget constraint at D or F, rather than at B.
p48.zh: Petunia 的偏好。其他人可能会做出其他选择。 例如,一个人的替代和收入对休闲的影响完全相互抵消,他可能会用像D这样的选择来应对更高的工资,完全高于最初的选择A,这意味着以收入形式享受较高的工资的所有好处,同时工作的时间也相同。另一位对休闲的替代效应超过了收入效应的人,可能会对较高的工资作出反应,做出像F这样的选择,因为F对较高工资的反应是工作时间更长,收入要高得多。 为了代表这些不同的偏好,你可以轻松地画出冷漠曲线 Uh 切合D或F的新预算限制,而不是B预算限制.

p50.original: Quentin has saved up $10,000. He is thinking about spending some or all of it on a vacation in the present, and then will save the rest for another big vacation five years from now. Over those five years, he expects to earn a total 80% rate of return.  shows Quentin’s budget constraint and his indifference curves between present consumption and future consumption. The highest level of utility that Quentin can achieve at his original intertemporal budget constraint occurs at point A, where he is consuming $6,000, saving $4,000 for the future, and expecting with the accumulated interest to have $7,200 for future consumption (that is, $4,000 in current financial savings plus the 80% rate of return).
p50.zh: 昆汀省了一万块 他考虑用一部分或全部 来度假, 然后会节省剩下的 5年后的又一个大假期。 这五年来,他预计总回报率会达到80 % 。 这表明昆廷的预算拮据,以及他目前消费与未来消费之间的冷漠曲线。昆廷在最初的时空预算限制下所能达到的最高效用水平发生在A点,他正在消耗6000美元,为未来节省了4000美元,并且预计累积利息中还有7200美元用于未来的消费(即4000美元目前的财务节余加上80%的回报率).

p51.original: However, Quentin has just realized that his expected rate of return was unrealistically high. A more realistic expectation is that over five years he can earn a total return of 30%. In effect, his intertemporal budget constraint has pivoted to the left, so that his original utility-maximizing choice is no longer available. Will Quentin react to the lower rate of return by saving more, or less, or the same amount? Again, the language of substitution and income effects provides a framework for thinking about the motivations behind various choices. The dashed line, which is a graphical tool to separate the substitution and income effect, is carefully inserted with the same slope as the new opportunity set, so that it reflects the changed rate of return, but it is tangent to the original indifference curve, so that it shows no change in utility or “buying power.”
p51.zh: 然而,昆廷刚刚意识到他的预期回报率不现实地很高. 一个更现实的期望是,在五年内,他能够获得30%的总回报。 实际上,他的时际预算限制已经向左偏转,因此他原先的功用最大化选择不再可用.昆廷会通过多节省或少节省或相同数额来对较低的回报率作出反应吗? 同样,替代和收入影响的语言为思考各种选择背后的动机提供了一个框架。虚线是区分替代和收入效应的图形工具,它被小心地插入到与新机会设定相同的坡度上,从而反映回报率的变化,但与原无动于衷的曲线是切合的,因此它显示效用或“购买力”没有变化。

p52.original: The substitution effect tells how Quentin would have altered his consumption because the lower rate of return makes future consumption relatively more expensive and present consumption relatively cheaper. The movement from the original choice A to point C shows how Quentin substitutes toward more present consumption and less future consumption in response to the lower interest rate, with no change in utility. The substitution arrows on the horizontal and vertical axes of  show the direction of the substitution effect motivation. The substitution effect suggests that, because of the lower interest rate, Quentin should consume more in the present and less in the future.
p52.zh: 替代效应说明昆廷会如何改变他的消费,因为收益率较低使得未来的消费相对昂贵,而现在的消费相对便宜. 从最初的选择A到指C的移动表明昆廷如何取代现在的消费,而随着利率的降低而减少将来的消费,其效用没有变化。水平轴和垂直轴上的替代箭头显示替代效果动机的方向.替代效应表明,由于利率较低,昆廷现在的消费应该更多,将来应该更少.

p53.original: Quentin also has an income effect motivation. The lower rate of return shifts the budget constraint to the left, which means that Quentin’s utility or “buying power” is reduced. The income effect (assuming normal goods) encourages less of both present and future consumption. The impact of the income effect on reducing present and future consumption in this example is shown with “i” arrows on the horizontal and vertical axis of .
p53.zh: 昆廷也有收入效应动机.较低的回报率将预算限制转向左,这意味着昆廷的效用或 " 购买力 " 减少。收入影响(假定是正常商品)鼓励减少目前和今后的消费。收入影响对减少目前和今后消费的影响,在本例子中以“i”箭头显示在......的横向和纵向轴上。

p54.original: Indifference Curve and an Intertemporal Budget Constraint
p54.zh: 偏差曲线和间期预算约束

p55.original: Taking both effects together, the substitution effect is encouraging Quentin toward more present and less future consumption, because present consumption is relatively cheaper, while the income effect is encouraging him to less present and less future consumption, because the lower interest rate is pushing him to a lower level of utility. For Quentin’s personal preferences, the substitution effect is stronger so that, overall, he reacts to the lower rate of return with more present consumption and less savings at choice B. However, other people might have different preferences. They might react to a lower rate of return by choosing the same level of present consumption and savings at choice D, or by choosing less present consumption and more savings at a point like F. For these other sets of preferences, the income effect of a lower rate of return on present consumption would be relatively stronger, while the substitution effect would be relatively weaker.
p55.zh: 将这两种效应结合起来,替代效应正在鼓励昆廷实现更现时和更少的未来消费,因为目前的消费相对便宜,而收入效应则鼓励他减少现时和更少的未来消费,因为较低的利率正在将他推向更低的效用水平. 对于昆廷的个人偏好,替代效果更强,这样,总的来说,他用更现时的消费和更少的储蓄来反应较低的回报率。 然而,其他人可能有不同的偏好. 它们可能会对较低的回报率作出反应,在选择D时选择相同的现有消费和储蓄水平,或者在像F时选择较少的当前消费和更多的储蓄。 对于这些其他优惠,目前消费收益率较低的收入效应将相对更强,而替代效应则相对弱一些。

p57.original: Indifference curves provide an analytical tool for looking at all the choices that provide a single level of utility. They eliminate any need for placing numerical values on utility and help to illuminate the process of making utility-maximizing decisions. They also provide the basis for a more detailed investigation of the complementary motivations that arise in response to a change in a price, wage or rate of return—namely, the substitution and income effects.
p57.zh: 偏差曲线提供了一个分析工具,用于审视所有提供单一水平效用的选择。 它们消除了将数字值放在公用事业上的任何需要,并有助于阐明使公用事业最大化的决定的过程。 它们还为更详细地调查价格、工资或回报率变化引起的补充动机,即替代和收入影响,提供了基础。

p58.original: If you are finding it a little tricky to sketch diagrams that show substitution and income effects so that the points of tangency all come out correctly, it may be useful to follow this procedure.
p58.zh: 如果你发现画出显示替代和收入效应的图表有点困难, 以便正确得出准确的点, 遵循这个程序也许是有益的。

p59.original: Step 1. Begin with a budget constraint showing the choice between two goods, which this example will call “candy” and “movies.” Choose a point A which will be the optimal choice, where the indifference curve will be tangent—but it is often easier not to draw in the indifference curve just yet. See .
p59.zh: 步骤1。首先是预算限制,表明两种商品之间的选择,这个例子将称之为“杂货 ” 和“杂货 ” 。 选择最佳选择的A点,即冷漠的曲线是切合的 — — 但是,在冷漠的曲线中不画出来往往比较容易。 见.

p61.original: Step 2. Now the price of movies changes: let’s say that it rises. That shifts the budget set inward. You know that the higher price will push the decision-maker down to a lower level of utility, represented by a lower indifference curve. But at this stage, draw only the new budget set. See .
p61.zh: 步骤二. 现在电影的价格会变:让我们假设电影会上升。 这样预算就向内转移了。 你知道,更高的价格会把决策者推低到较低的效用水平,以较低的冷漠曲线为代表. 但在现阶段,只提取新的预算。 见.

p63.original: Step 3. The key tool in distinguishing between substitution and income effects is to insert a dashed line, parallel to the new budget line. This line is a graphical tool that allows you to distinguish between the two changes: (1) the effect on consumption of the two goods of the shift in prices—with the level of utility remaining unchanged—which is the substitution effect; and (2) the effect on consumption of the two goods of shifting from one indifference curve to the other—with relative prices staying unchanged—which is the income effect. The dashed line is inserted in this step. The trick is to have the dashed line travel close to the original choice A, but not directly through point A. See .
p63.zh: 步骤3。区分替代和收入影响的关键工具是插入一条与新预算项目平行的虚线。这条线是一个图形工具,可以区分两种变化:(1) 价格变动对两种商品消费的影响—— 效用水平保持不变—— 这是替代效应;(2) 两种商品从一种冷漠曲线转向另一种,相对价格保持不变—— 这是收入效应。 此步骤中插入了破折线。诀窍是让破折线旅行接近原选择A,但不能直接通过点A. 见.

p65.original: Step 4. Now, draw the original indifference curve, so that it is tangent to both point A on the original budget line and to a point C on the dashed line. Many students find it easiest to first select the tangency point C where the original indifference curve touches the dashed line, and then to draw the original indifference curve through A and C. The substitution effect is illustrated by the movement along the original indifference curve as prices change but the level of utility holds constant, from A to C. As expected, the substitution effect leads to less consumed of the good that is relatively more expensive, as shown by the “s” (substitution) arrow on the vertical axis, and more consumed of the good that is relatively less expensive, as shown by the “s” arrow on the horizontal axis. See .
p65.zh: 步骤4。 现在,画出最初的冷漠曲线,这样它就与原预算线上的A点和破折线上的C点相吻合。 许多学生认为最容易先选择原始的冷漠曲线触及破折线的切切点C,然后通过A和C绘制原始的冷漠曲线.替代效应表现在最初的冷漠曲线上随着价格变化而变化,但效用水平保持不变,从A到C。 如预期,替代效应导致相对昂贵的商品消耗较少,如纵向轴上的“s”(替代)箭头所示,而相对便宜的商品消耗较多,如横向轴上的“s”箭头所示。 见.

p67.original: Step 5. With the substitution effect in place, now choose utility-maximizing point B on the new opportunity set. When you choose point B, think about whether you wish the substitution or the income effect to have a larger impact on the good (in this case, candy) on the horizontal axis. If you choose point B to be directly in a vertical line with point A (as is illustrated here), then the income effect will be exactly offsetting the substitution effect on the horizontal axis. If you insert point B so that it lies a little to right of the original point A, then the substitution effect will exceed the income effect. If you insert point B so that it lies a little to the left of point A, then the income effect will exceed the substitution effect. The income effect is the movement from C to B, showing how choices shifted as a result of the decline in buying power and the movement between two levels of utility, with relative prices remaining the same. With normal goods, the negative income effect means less consumed of each good, as shown by the direction of the “i” (income effect) arrows on the vertical and horizontal axes. See .
p67.zh: 步骤5。 随着替代效应的到位,现在在新机会集上选择功用最大化点B. 当选择点B时,考虑你是否希望替代物或收入效应对水平轴上的好(在此情况下是糖果)产生更大的影响. 如果选择点B直接与点A垂直线(如本文所示),那么收入效应将完全抵消对水平轴的替代效应. 如果插入点B使其略偏右于原点A,那么替代效应将超过收入效应. 如果插入点B使其稍稍位于点A的左侧,那么收入效应将超过替代效应.收入效应是从C到B的变动,显示选择权如何因购买力下降和两个层次的公用事业之间的变动而转变,相对价格保持不变. 在正常商品中,负收入影响意味着每种商品消耗较少,如纵向和横向轴上的“i”(收入影响)箭头的方向所示。 见.

p69.original: In sketching substitution and income effect diagrams, you may wish to practice some of the following variations: (1) Price falls instead of a rising; (2) The price change affects the good on either the vertical or the horizontal axis; (3) Sketch these diagrams so that the substitution effect exceeds the income effect; the income effect exceeds the substitution effect; and the two effects are equal.
p69.zh: 在绘制替代和收入效应图时,您不妨实践以下一些变体:(1)价格下跌而不是上升;(2)价格变动影响垂直或水平轴上的好;(3)勾勒这些图,使替代效应超过收入效应;收入效应超过替代效应;以及两种效应是等效的.

p70.original: One final note: The helpful dashed line can be drawn tangent to the new indifference curve, and parallel to the original budget line, rather than tangent to the original indifference curve and parallel to the new budget line. Some students find this approach more intuitively clear. The answers you get about the direction and relative sizes of the substitution and income effects, however, should be the same.
p70.zh: 最后一点:有用的虚线可以与新的冷漠曲线直接对应,并与原来的预算项目平行,而不是与原来的冷漠曲线平行,与新的预算项目平行。 一些学生认为这种方法更直观地清晰. 但是,你得到的关于替代和收入影响的方向和相对大小的答案应该是一样的。

p72.original: An indifference curve is drawn on a budget constraint diagram that shows the tradeoffs between two goods. All points along a single indifference curve provide the same level of utility. Higher indifference curves represent higher levels of utility. Indifference curves slope downward because, if utility is to remain the same at all points along the curve, a reduction in the quantity of the good on the vertical axis must be counterbalanced by an increase in the quantity of the good on the horizontal axis (or vice versa). Indifference curves are steeper on the far left and flatter on the far right, because of diminishing marginal utility.
p72.zh: 一种冷漠的曲线来自预算限制图,显示两种商品之间的权衡。沿着单一的冷漠曲线的所有点都提供同样程度的效用.更高的冷漠曲线代表了更高的效用水平.偏差曲线向下倾斜,因为如果要在沿曲线的所有点保持效用不变,纵向轴上的好物质数量减少就必须通过水平轴上的好物质数量增加来抵消(反之亦然).偏差曲线在最左边较陡,在最右边较夸张,因为边际效用逐渐减少.

p73.original: The utility-maximizing choice along a budget constraint will be the point of tangency where the budget constraint touches an indifference curve at a single point. A change in the price of any good has two effects: a substitution effect and an income effect. The substitution effect motivation encourages a utility-maximizer to buy less of what is relatively more expensive and more of what is relatively cheaper. The income effect motivation encourages a utility-maximizer to buy more of both goods if utility rises or less of both goods if utility falls (if they are both normal goods).
p73.zh: 预算约束带来的最大效用选择将是紧要的点,因为预算约束在某一点上触及到冷漠曲线。任何货物价格的变动都会产生两个影响:替代效应和收入效应。替代效应的动机鼓励一种公用事业放大剂购买价格相对较高的产品,价格相对较低的产品。收入效应动机鼓励公用事业最大者在公用事业增加或公用事业减少(如果两者均为正常商品)时购买更多的两种商品。

p74.original: In a labor-leisure choice, every wage change has a substitution and an income effect. The substitution effect of a wage increase is to choose more income, since it is cheaper to earn, and less leisure, since its opportunity cost has increased. The income effect of a wage increase is to choose more of leisure and income, since they are both normal goods. The substitution and income effects of a wage decrease would reverse these directions.
p74.zh: 在劳动-劳动选择中,每次工资变动都具有替代和收入效应。增加工资的替代作用是选择更多的收入,因为收入更便宜,休闲更少,因为机会成本增加。增加工资对收入的影响是选择更多的休闲和收入,因为它们都是正常商品。工资下降的替代和收入影响将扭转这些方向。

p75.original: In an intertemporal consumption choice, every interest rate change has a substitution and an income effect. The substitution effect of an interest rate increase is to choose more future consumption, since it is now cheaper to earn future consumption and less present consumption (more savings), since the opportunity cost of present consumption in terms of what is being given up in the future has increased. The income effect of an interest rate increase is to choose more of both present and future consumption, since they are both normal goods. The substitution and income effects of an interest rate decrease would reverse these directions.
p75.zh: 在间歇性消费选择中,每个利率变动都具有替代和收入效应.利率增加的替代作用是选择更多的未来消费,因为现在赚取未来消费的费用更低,现在的消费减少(更多的储蓄),因为目前消费的机会成本随着未来放弃而增加。利率增长的收入影响是选择更多当前和未来消费,因为它们都是正常商品。利率下降的替代和收入影响将扭转这些方向。

p77.original: What point is preferred along an indifference curve?
p77.zh: 在冷漠的曲线上,更喜欢什么?

p78.original: Why do indifference curves slope down?
p78.zh: 为什么冷漠会向下倾斜?

p79.original: Why are indifference curves steep on the left and flatter on the right?
p79.zh: 为什么冷漠的曲线在左边陡峭,在右边恭维呢?

p80.original: How many indifference curves does a person have?
p80.zh: 一个人有多少冷漠曲线?

p81.original: How can you tell which indifference curves represent higher or lower levels of utility?
p81.zh: 如何分辨哪个冷漠曲线代表更高或较低的效用水平?

p84.original: Does the “income effect” involve a change in income? Explain.
p84.zh: “收入影响”是否涉及收入变化?解释一下

p85.original: Does a change in price have both an income effect and a substitution effect? Does a change in income have both an income effect and a substitution effect?
p85.zh: 价格变化是否既具有收入影响,又具有替代影响?收入变化是否既具有收入影响,又具有替代影响?

p86.original: Would you expect, in some cases, to see only an income effect or only a substitution effect? Explain.
p86.zh: 在某些情况下,你期望只看到收入效应,还是只看到替代效应?解释一下

p87.original: Which is larger, the income effect or the substitution effect?
p87.zh: 哪些是较大的,收入效应还是替代效应?

c0.original: Lilly would receive equal utility from all points on a given indifference curve. Any points on the highest indifference curve Uh, like F, provide greater utility than any points like A, B, C, and D on the middle indifference curve Um. Similarly, any points on the middle indifference curve Um provide greater utility than any points on the lowest indifference curve Ul.
c0.zh: 莉莉从一个冷漠的曲线上 从所有点上都会得到同样的好处最高的冷漠曲线上的任何点 和F一样 比中间的冷漠曲线上A,B,C,D等任何点都有用 同样,中间冷漠曲线上的任何点都比最低冷漠曲线上的任何点都具有更大的效用。

c1.original: Lilly’s preferences are shown by the indifference curves. Lilly’s budget constraint, given the prices of books and doughnuts and her income, is shown by the straight line. Lilly’s optimal choice will be point B, where the budget line is tangent to the indifference curve Um. Lilly would have more utility at a point like F on the higher indifference curve Uh, but the budget line does not touch the higher indifference curve Uh at any point, so she cannot afford this choice. A choice like G is affordable to Lilly, but it lies on indifference curve Ul and thus provides less utility than choice B, which is on indifference curve Um.
c1.zh: 莉莉的偏好通过冷漠曲线来表现.Lilly的预算拮据, 以书籍和甜甜圈的价格及收入来看,利利的最佳选择将是B点, 预算项目与冷漠曲线Um紧凑。莉莉在F的冷漠曲线上会更有用 但预算线上不会触及到 更高冷漠曲线 所以她买不起这个选择 像G这样的选择对莉莉来说是负担得起的,但它位于冷漠曲线Ul,因此与选择B相比,其实用性较低,而选择B位于冷漠曲线Um.

c2.original: Manuel and Natasha originally face the same budget constraints; that is, same prices and same income. However, the indifference curves that illustrate their preferences are not the same. (a) Manuel’s original choice at W involves more yogurt and more movies, and he reacts to the higher income by mainly increasing consumption of movies at X. (b) Conversely, Natasha’s original choice (Y) involves relatively more movies, but she reacts to the higher income by choosing relatively more yogurts. Even when budget constraints are the same, personal preferences lead to different original choices and to different reactions in response to a change in income.
c2.zh: 曼努埃尔和娜塔莎最初面临同样的预算限制,即相同的价格和同样的收入。 然而,表明他们偏好的各种冷漠曲线却不同。(a) Manuel在W的最初选择涉及更多的酸奶和更多的电影,他主要通过增加X的电影消费来应对收入较高的问题.(b) 相反,娜塔莎最初的选择(Y)涉及的电影相对较多,但她通过选择相对更多的酸奶来对收入较高者作出反应. 即使预算限制相同,个人偏好也会导致不同的原始选择,以及因收入变化而产生不同的反应.

c3.original: The original choice is A, the point of tangency between the original budget constraint and indifference curve. The new choice is B, the point of tangency between the new budget constraint and the lower indifference curve. Point C is the tangency between the dashed line, where the slope shows the new higher price of haircuts, and the original indifference curve. The substitution effect is the shift from A to C, which means getting fewer haircuts and more pizza. The income effect is the shift from C to B; that is, the reduction in buying power that causes a shift from the higher indifference curve to the lower indifference curve, with relative prices remaining unchanged. The income effect results in less consumed of both goods. Both substitution and income effects cause fewer haircuts to be consumed. For pizza, in this case, the substitution effect and income effect cancel out, leading to the same amount of pizza consumed.
c3.zh: 最初的选择是A,是原始预算限制和冷漠曲线之间的不切实际点.新的选择是B,即新的预算限制和较低的冷漠曲线之间的紧凑点。C点是折叠线之间的紧凑性,坡度显示发型新的较高价格,与最初的冷漠曲线.替代效果是从A到C的转变,这意味着剪发次数减少,披萨也更多.收入影响是从C到B的转变;即购买力的下降,导致从更高的冷漠曲线转向较低的冷漠曲线,相对价格保持不变.收入效应导致这两种商品消耗较少。替代和收入影响都导致理发减少。 对于披萨来说,在这种情况下,替代效应和收入效应取消,导致同样数量的披萨消费.

c4.original: Petunia starts at choice A, the tangency between her original budget constraint and the lower indifference curve Ul. The wage increase shifts her budget constraint to the right, so that she can now choose B on indifference curve Uh. The substitution effect is the movement from A to C. In this case, the substitution effect would lead Petunia to choose less leisure, which is relatively more expensive, and more income, which is relatively cheaper to earn. The income effect is the movement from C to B. The income effect in this example leads to greater consumption of both goods. Overall, in this example, income rises because of both substitution and income effects. However, leisure declines because of the substitution effect but increases because of the income effect—leading, in Petunia’s case, to an overall increase in the quantity of leisure consumed.
c4.zh: Petunia从选择A开始,她最初的预算限制与低等的冷漠曲线Ul之间的紧凑性.工资增长将她的预算限制转移到了右侧,这样她现在可以选择B在冷漠曲线上 Uh.替代效应是从A到C的移动. 在这种情况下,替代效应会导致佩图尼亚选择较少的闲暇,相对昂贵,收入较多,收入相对便宜.收入影响是从C到B的移动. 这一例子对收入的影响导致两种商品消费增加。总的来说,就这个例子而言,收入增加是因为替代和收入影响。 然而,休闲因替代效应而减少,但因收入效应而增加,就佩图尼亚而言,导致休闲消费总量全面增加。

c5.original: The original choice is A, at the tangency between the original budget constraint and the original indifference curve Uh. The dashed line is drawn parallel to the new budget set, so that its slope reflects the lower rate of return, but is tangent to the original indifference curve. The movement from A to C is the substitution effect: in this case, future consumption has become relatively more expensive, and present consumption has become relatively cheaper. The income effect is the shift from C to B; that is, the reduction in utility or “buying power” that causes a move to a lower indifference curve Ul, but with the relative price the same. It means less present and less future consumption. In the move from A to B, the substitution effect on present consumption is greater than the income effect, so the overall result is more present consumption. Notice that the lower indifference curve could have been drawn tangent to the lower budget constraint point D or point F, depending on personal preferences.
c5.zh: 最初的选择是A, 在最初的预算限制和最初的冷漠曲线之间不紧凑 Uh.虚线与新预算设置平行划出,使其坡度反映较低的回报率,但与最初的冷漠曲线紧凑. 从A到C的移动是替代效应:在这种情况下,未来的消费已经相对地变得更加昂贵,而目前的消费也变得相对便宜.收入效应是从C到B的转变;即公用事业或“购买力”的减少导致转向低冷漠曲线Ul,但相对价格不变。 这意味着现在和将来的消费减少。 在从A到B的移动中,对当前消费的替代效应大于收入效应,因此总体结果更是当前消费.通知,低冷漠曲线可能与较低的预算限制点D或F直接相关,这取决于个人偏好。
